content:
Hi! I'm Jyotirmoy Bhattacharya, from New Delhi India (www.jyotirmoy.net). To get a feel for Lean I formalized Fourier-Motzkin elimination for linear inequalities and theorems of the alternative. I'd really appreciate any feedback.

The code is here: https://github.com/jmoy/farkas_lean

I use Claude/Codex to fill in all the algebraic steps. So rather than the tactical level, I'd particularly like feedback on whether I've formalized the statements in a idiomatic way and used a proper organization for the project.
A message was moved here from #new members > Hello & graph coloring exercises by Vlad Tsyrklevich.

Good job!

Can you unfold Farkas1Primal and Farkas1Dual in the statement of Farkas1Exhaust please?
Can you unfold InCone2 and HasDualCert2 in the statement of farkas2 please?
Can you please write operators like ᵥ* consistently everywhere?
Currently, your repo is hard to read.

Can you please also provide the corollaries which say that exactly one thing happens?

FYI, I proved some generalizations of these results. I can share if you want to see what I did.
